pages.text: Hi!这里是火辣的博客,很高兴认识你~

/* ────────────────────────────────────────── 火辣的生活记录 · 创意定制样式 ────────────────────────────────────────── */ /* 导航栏：磨砂玻璃质感 */ #nav { background: rgba(253, 250, 245, 0.85) !important; backdrop-filter: blur(16px) !important; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) !important; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(180, 130, 80, 0.08) !important; } /* 站点标题：字间距拉开，更有仪式感 */ #site-name, .blog-info-name { letter-spacing: 0.15em !important; } /* 卡片：更大圆角 + 柔和阴影 + 悬停上浮 */ .card-widget, .recent-post-item, .post-card-wrap { border-radius: 20px !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(150, 100, 60, 0.07) !important; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) !important; } .card-widget:hover, .recent-post-item:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) !important; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(150, 100, 60, 0.13) !important; } /* 文章标题悬停时字间距微微展开 */ .article-title a { transition: letter-spacing 0.3s ease !important; } .article-title a:hover { letter-spacing: 0.04em !important; } /* 标签：胶囊形状 */ .tag-outer .tag, a.tag { border-radius: 20px !important; padding: 2px 14px !important; } /* 引用块：左边换成暖色竖线 */ blockquote { border-left-color: #C4884E !important; background: rgba(196, 136, 78, 0.05) !important; border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0 !important; font-style: italic; color: #7a6050 !important; } /* 页脚：暖色渐变 */ #footer { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F7F0E6 0%, #F0E8DA 100%) !important; color: #9B8577 !important; } #footer a, #footer .copyright { color: #9B8577 !important; } /* 文章内容行高更宽松，更像在翻日记 */ #article-container p { line-height: 2.2 !important; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } /* 分割线：换成小钻石装饰 */ #article-container hr { border: none !important; text-align: center; overflow: visible; } #article-container hr::after { content: '◆ ◇ ◆'; display: inline-block; position: relative; top: -0.7em; font-size: 0.65em; color: #C4884E; letter-spacing: 0.4em; background: var(--global-bg); padding: 0 0.5em; } /* 回到顶部按钮：暖色 */ #go-up { background: #C4884E !important; }

#wechat-qr-popup { position: fixed; display: none; z-index: 1001; padding: 8px; background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); pointer-events: none; } #wechat-qr-popup img { display: block; width: 160px; height: 160px; object-fit: contain; } #wechat-qr-popup p { margin: 6px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: #333; }

(function () { function init() { var popup = document.getElementById('wechat-qr-popup'); if (!popup) { popup = document.createElement('div'); popup.id = 'wechat-qr-popup'; popup.innerHTML = '扫码加我微信'; document.body.appendChild(popup); } var links = document.querySelectorAll('a'); for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) { (function (a) { if (!a.querySelector('.fa-weixin')) return; if (a.dataset.wechatBound) return; a.dataset.wechatBound = '1'; a.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { var rect = a.getBoundingClientRect(); popup.style.display = 'block'; var popupWidth = popup.offsetWidth; var left = rect.left + rect.width / 2 - popupWidth / 2; left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - popupWidth - 8)); popup.style.left = left + 'px'; popup.style.top = rect.bottom + 10 + 'px'; }); a.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { popup.style.display = 'none'; }); a.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }); })(links[i]); } } if (document.readyState !== 'loading') { init(); } else { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); } })();
视频目录请将视频文件放在此目录，文件名对应如下： moments.mp4 → 一些瞬间 glimpses.mp4 → 浮光掠影 letters.mp4 → 鸿雁传书 sounds.mp4 → 丝竹管弦 支持格式：mp4（推荐）/ webm / movGitHub Pages 单文件限制 100MB，超出建议用 Bilibili/YouTube iframe 替代。
